newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The UAE's minister of finance and industry said his country welcomed Arab nationals in its workforce.
- Dubai has arrested over 600 expatriates for violating the country's tough new labour law.
- Crescent Petroleum has signed a contract to sell a 40 percent stake to Taiwan's state-run Chinese Petroleum Corp for $75 million.
- The Sharjah Oil Refining Co is negotiating to buy its third Canadian oil refinery but the deal is facing local opposition.
- A $38 million five year loan facility has been arranged for the recently set up United Gulf Bank of Bahrain by the Dubai-based investment banking unit HSBC Financial Services (Middle East).
- Mitsubishi Motors Corp announced the opening of its 10 million dirham Middle East Parts Centre in Dubai's Jebel Ali Free Zone.
- Air Algerie will start operations from Dubai in April.
